title: Revisiting crossed-correlated baths in open quantum systems simulated by HEOM or T-TEDOPA
summary: Excited-state dynamics of open quantum systems is analyzed by the hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) or the thermalized time-evolving density operator with orthogonal polynomials algorithm (T-TEDOPA) method when a discrete $ab$ $initio$ linear vibronic model is parametrized by continuous temperature-dependent spectral densities leading to crossed correlation functions, i.e. correlated fluctuations of the energy gap collective modes.
